reason: My register has never let me down, and my staff and I know it inside out. Paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month to type numbers into phones, when half my ladies won't even give their mobile number, doesn't make sense for a small parlour like mine.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, so the reminders, wallet and WhatsApp bills won't work for most of them, and I'll still end up keeping the register anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked without needing the customer's mobile number and another salon owner nearby showed me it actually stopped cash going missing from the drawer.
